Chose: repair one end-to-end chain - signal predicate + content hash in post_tool_use.py before observe then purge the 84%-noise corpus; swap embedder to multilingual paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 at 384 dim (cheap because the purge cuts 17.3k rows to ~2.7k); ORDER BY rank + real BM25 distance + source field in memory.py FTS path; invert injection default to zero-unless-it-clears-a-relative-floor; gate docs injection off until the index is real; plan fields Rollback/Breaking change/Anchor become exception-only enforced by existing ec-review Stage 1.5; split Verify into local evidence (per task, ms) vs global invariants (module boundary + review); honest Dependencies actually consumed by ec-execute for co-location fusion (41 tasks -> ~25 units) and ordering; range reads instead of 18120-token whole-plan reads; fix etok git status dead branch and git log --oneline data loss plus the shell wrapper leak that kept a measured 74% build-log saving permanently dormant; delete duplicate non-prefixed command family. Because: Tier-1-only scores highest on composite (20 vs 16) but fails the pre-mortem - it makes scores honest without making retrieval useful, since the English-only embedder leaves all 4 benchmark queries at distance 1.19-1.25 against a 1.2 threshold, and it touches none of the 18.1k plan bloat or 93s compile cost. Key unmeasured assumption: a multilingual 384-dim model on the de-noised corpus clears a real relevance bar; the relative floor makes failure safe (zero injection) with bge-m3 as fallback.

observations.content: Brainstorm: Collapsible Right Rail with Git Properties. Chose: right aside becomes three independently collapsible sections (Properties, Tasks, History) sharing one header component that reuses the tree-row chevron glyph; collapse state persisted in studio.json (safe because every StudioConfig field already carries serde default) — deliberately the OPPOSITE of the sidebar expansion state, which is session-only because it views the filesystem while panel collapse is a preference. Properties reports the active folder branch and offers exactly two writes: checkout existing local branch, create new branch. Because: two decisive pieces of evidence. (1) git on this machine is a SHELL FUNCTION, the etok wrapper install.sh appends to .zshrc via shell/effi-shell.sh, which pipes branch/status/diff output through $ETOK — so Studio must exec the resolved git BINARY directly via login_shell_path like resolve_claude, never through zsh -ilc, or the branch list would be run through the token optimizer. (2) .git/packed-refs exists, so reading .git/refs/heads/ alone would silently omit packed branches. Also: watcher.rs:25-35 watches only .claude/ so .git/HEAD changes are invisible — a successful checkout must return fresh state rather than wait for an event that never arrives. No --force, no auto-stash, no auto-commit; git stderr surfaced verbatim and the operation stops, which is both what the user asked and what keeps /ec-git the sole writer of history. plan.rs current_branch stays file-based because the watcher calls it per debounced event and must not acquire a subprocess dependency.
